title: Sci-Fi Films
story: Three cozy trips through the galaxy of space movies.

cards.name: Rocket
cards.subject: A chubby retro rocket with a pointed nose cone, round porthole window and three fins.

cards.name: Flying Saucer
cards.subject: A classic silver flying saucer with a glass dome on top and a ring of little round lights.

cards.name: Ringed Planet
cards.subject: A round planet with soft bands of color and one big tilted ring around it.

cards.name: Space Helmet
cards.subject: A round glass-front space helmet with a collar ring and a small antenna on the side.

cards.name: Moon Rock
cards.subject: A lumpy grey moon rock with small craters and a sparkling crystal vein.

cards.name: Control Panel
cards.subject: A slanted control console with big round buttons, a bright screen and a chunky lever.

cards.name: Moon Rover
cards.subject: A six-wheeled moon buggy with an open seat, a dish antenna and a tiny flag.
cards.surface_or_setting: grey moon dust with small craters

cards.name: Star Map
cards.subject: A big unrolled paper chart with dotted star routes, small planets and a compass rose.

cards.name: Space Station
cards.subject: A ring-shaped space station with solar panels, a central hub and glowing windows, floating above Earth.

cards.name: Launch Pad
cards.subject: A tall launch tower with a rocket standing beside it and puffs of friendly smoke.

cards.name: Jetpack
cards.subject: A twin-tank backpack with two nozzles, small fins and glowing orange flames.

cards.name: Hover Board

cards.name: Glow Crystal

cards.name: Energy Cell
cards.subject: A chunky glass battery canister with glowing green liquid and metal caps.

cards.name: Teleport Pad
cards.subject: A round glowing platform with a ring of lights and sparkling beams rising above it.

cards.name: Robot Arm
cards.subject: A jointed factory arm with a round base, two segments and a gentle claw holding a gear.

cards.name: Hologram Globe
cards.subject: A small projector disc beaming a floating glowing planet with tiny orbiting dots.

cards.name: Dome City
cards.subject: A glass-domed city with tall rounded towers, little bridges and glowing windows.

cards.name: Time Machine
cards.subject: A round brass-and-glass machine with a big dial, a cozy seat and a spinning ring.

cards.name: Flying Saucer
cards.subject: A tiny round saucer with a bubble top, three feet and a soft beam of light below.

cards.name: Comet
cards.subject: A round icy comet with a long curved sparkling tail trailing behind.

cards.name: Satellite
cards.subject: A boxy satellite with two big square solar wings and a small dish on top.

cards.subject: A long telescope with a wide lens, a tripod and a small finder scope.

cards.name: Crater Camp
